sync_note: Anchors couple the hold recovery model to the real files. Each marker is the guard line plus its first effect line (card 1014). Line numbers are hints; the check matches the marker string and expected_count.

anchors.marker:
SELECT id, desk_id INTO v_id, v_held
    FROM hold
   WHERE resource_id = v_res
   FOR UPDATE;

WHERE id = v_id AND desk_id IS NULL;
    SET v_n = ROW_COUNT();

ELSEIF v_held = v_desk THEN
    -- Same holder again refreshes the row (#194). It does not stack a second lock and writes no move row.
    -- Card 853: bump updated for #194, but report since as the take time (activity.updated),
    -- so a second hold keeps since and sets refreshed true.
    SELECT a.updated INTO v_since FROM activity a WHERE a.type = 'hold' AND a.id = v_id;

WHERE id = p_id AND desk_id = v_desk;
  SET v_gone = ROW_COUNT();

anchors.property: Admin/stale drop of another's hold (card 931 / F223)

anchors.marker:
WHERE id = p_id AND desk_id = v_expect;
    SET v_gone = ROW_COUNT();

anchors.property: Admin may drop other (F223); pairs with stale-days

anchors.marker:
need = hold_stale_days()
    if age is None or age < float(need):
anchors.property: stale bound for high-trust non-Admin release-other
